name: Cole
bio: The name Cole appears for a Montana cattleman from Miles City who visited in July 1884, and in 1885 for a "Bro. Cole" who, the paper joked, would now have a force pump by the company's office for watering trees in "the Park" and a "His Honor Cole" who got soaked crossing Sully creek. The excerpts do not show whether these are the same man.

moments.label: Montana cattleman Cole visited from Miles City

mentions: Mr. Cole, one of Montana's cattle kings, was down from Miles City yesterday and spent the day in town.

The well by the company's office has been supplied with a force pump 40 man power. Bro, Cole will now have something with which to occupy his many leisure moments, squirting water on trees and grass that have lately been planted in "the Park."

…discourage any future comers from attempting to cross by seeing where the horse had turned around. His Honor Cole coming along behind and thinking where man had crossed before, there he could cross, plunged boldly in. That is the reason Cole is wearing a clean shirt.
